description: `getInstance` documents 410 in the spec (`responses.410`), and convert drops it because the model has no error shape for it, so it surfaces as UnknownStackitError. STACKIT's Go SDK delete waiter (stackit-sdk-go services/rabbitmq/v2api/wait/wait.go, DeleteInstanceWaitHandler, read 2026-11-01) finishes on 410, and its Terraform provider (stackit/internal/services/rabbitmq/instance/resource.go, Read) treats 404 and 410 as gone. `getCredentials` doesn't list 410, but DeleteCredentialsWaitHandler in the same file finishes on 404 or 410. No live probe.
